body.statement:
For probability measures \(\mu\) and \(\nu\) on the same measurable space
and every binary test \(\varphi\),
\[
 \mathbb E_\mu\varphi+\mathbb E_\nu(1-\varphi)
 \ge 1-\operatorname{TV}(\mu,\nu).
\]

source.locator: Proof of Theorem 2.2(i), equation (2.28) and the following total-variation identity, pp. 90--91

attestation.note: The binary two-point average-error identity was transcribed from the proof of Tsybakov (2009), Theorem 2.2(i), equations (2.28) and the following display; multiplying by two gives the stated sum-risk inequality.
